title: A complete classification of the rational realization of gap-two products of Eilenberg--MacLane spaces as classifying spaces
summary: In this paper, we study the rational realization of the gap-two product $K(\mathbb{Q},n)\times K(\mathbb{Q},n+2)$ as the classifying space $B\mathrm{aut}_1(X)$ for a simply-connected $π$-finite space $X$ with rational homology of finite type. We prove that $K(\mathbb{Q},n)\times K(\mathbb{Q},n+2)$ can be realized as $B\mathrm{aut}_1(X)$ up to rational homotopy equivalence if and only if $n=3,4$ or $4m+2$ for $m\geq 1$.
